intervals.label: construction and operation at the CERN Neutrino Platform
intervals.note: The DUNE FD TDR Vol. I (2020) states that both ProtoDUNE prototypes had been constructed and operated at CERN, but gives no start or end date for ProtoDUNE-DP. The dual-phase line was subsequently discontinued in favour of the vertical-drift design.
intervals.quote: The DUNE collaboration has constructed and operated two large prototype detectors, ProtoDUNE-SP , and pddp , at CERN .

name: ProtoDUNE-DP
notes: Start and end dates and the liquid argon mass are unresolved; only the DUNE FD TDR Vol. I description could be fetched.

placements.note: Installed alongside ProtoDUNE-SP in the CERN Neutrino Platform hall in the CERN North Area; no installation date sourced.
placements.quote: ProtoDUNE-SP and ProtoDUNE-DP cryostats in the CERN Neutrino Platform in CERN ’s North Area.

drift_length.quote: ProtoDUNE-DP has a 6 m maximum drift length, half that planned for the DP module .

phase.quote: the single- and dual-phase DUNE liquid argon TPC far detector modules

target_medium.quote: the single- and dual-phase DUNE liquid argon TPC far detector modules

summary.plain: The second DUNE prototype at CERN. It tested a design in which the electron signal is amplified in a thin layer of argon gas above the liquid, allowing a much longer drift.
summary.technical: Dual-phase LArTPC prototype at the CERN Neutrino Platform with a single homogeneous drift volume and a 6 m maximum drift, about one twentieth of a DUNE far-detector module. The dual-phase technology was later superseded by the vertical-drift design for FD2.

technology.quote: Whereas the SP design has multiple drift volumes, the DP module design allows a single, fully homogeneous LAr volume with a much longer drift length.
technology.value: dual-phase liquid argon time projection chamber with a single homogeneous drift volume and charge amplification in the gas phase
